description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to managing update channels, including normalization, conversion to npm tags, and resolving effective channels based on configuration, git tags/branches, or defaults.

methods.name: normalizeUpdateChannel
methods.description: Normalizes a string value to a valid UpdateChannel or null.

methods.name: channelToNpmTag
methods.description: Converts an UpdateChannel to its corresponding npm tag string.

methods.name: isBetaTag
methods.description: Checks if a given tag string matches a beta version pattern.

methods.name: isStableTag
methods.description: Determines if a tag is considered stable (not beta).

methods.name: resolveEffectiveUpdateChannel
methods.description: Determines the effective update channel and its source based on configuration, git tags/branches, or defaults.

methods.name: formatUpdateChannelLabel
methods.description: Formats a label string for the update channel based on its source and optional git info.

methods.name: resolveUpdateChannelDisplay
methods.description: Resolves and formats the display information for the update channel, including label.
